ios.desc:
Build the skills you need for the job you have—or the one you want. With the O’Reilly app paired with a membership, you’ll get access to thousands of books, videos, and courses trusted by tech practitioners around the world. Whether you’re a developer, data professional, or technology leader, O’Reilly helps you stay ahead in a rapidly evolving industry.

Here are just a few ways you can use the O’Reilly app to learn today’s most critical skills:

• Explore the latest in programming, AI, cloud, DevOps, and cybersecurity, with content from the people actually putting the technology to work—plus in-depth content on leadership, soft skills, and much more.
• Discover best-selling titles and early releases from leading publishers, all in one digital library built for technology professionals.
• Listen to thousands of audiobooks to keep the learning going while you multitask.
• Watch live events and training sessions, or dive into 5,000+ courses on-demand.
• Use playlists to save and organize content you’re exploring, and share them with your friends and coworkers.
• Learn on the go, anywhere, with downloadable content and progress syncing across devices.
• Quickly find the resources that will help you solve the problems you encounter in your day-to-day work with AI-powered search, plus AI overviews (with citations) to get up to speed on the basics.

Powerful tools to support your learning:

• Recommendations based on your interests and history
• Playlists to organize the content you want to learn
• Deep search to find answers fast across 75K+ titles, 3.7K+ audiobooks, 30K+ hours of video, and much more
• Highlights and notes to capture key ideas
• Adjustable reading settings including font size and night mode
• Playback speed controls for faster learning

Get started with one of our most popular skills:

• AI and machine learning
• Software development and programming
• Data engineering and data science
• Cloud, DevOps, and infrastructure
• Cybersecurity
• Product management and leadership

The O’Reilly app works best with a membership. Learn more at oreilly.com.

android.desc:
Take O'Reilly online learning with you wherever you go, and put the knowledge of experts and the skills to stay ahead of business and technology trends in your pocket. 

With the O’Reilly app, you can:

Read, watch, or listen on the go: Explore books, videos, training sessions, courses, and more—online or off.

Never lose your place: With automatic syncing, you can start reading on one device and pick up where you left off on another.

Discover and organize with Playlists: Search for the exact content you want to read, watch, or listen to—then add it to a playlist and revisit it any time.

Personalize it: Adjust the text display for comfort with font size controls and a night mode setting.

Find what you need: Get the answers you need, fast, with the ability to easily search across books, videos, and more.

Make it work for you: Control the app with an external keyboard

** Please note that to use this application you must have an active (or trial) O'Reilly account created after July 2014. If you are an O'Reilly customer who joined before July 2014, please use our Safari To Go app, also available in the Play Store.**
